printing_publishing_activity.label: Printing / publishing activity
printing_publishing_activity.value: Digital and print magazine publishing through People Inc., plus digital news publishing through The Daily Beast.

print_digital_revenue_mix_publishers.label: Print / digital revenue mix [publishers]
print_digital_revenue_mix_publishers.value: Digital generates most of People Inc.’s publishing revenue, with print contributing a smaller share. The Daily Beast is digital-only.

publication_print_market.label: Publication / print market
publication_print_market.value: Consumer entertainment and lifestyle magazines, including PEOPLE and Better Homes & Gardens, plus digital news and commentary from The Daily Beast.

advertising_circulation_dependence_publi.label: Advertising / circulation dependence [publishers]
advertising_circulation_dependence_publi.value: People Inc. digital revenue is advertising-led. Print relies on subscriptions, advertising and newsstand sales. The Daily Beast earns advertising, subscription and licensing revenue.

paid_circulation_periodicals.label: Paid circulation [periodicals]
paid_circulation_periodicals.value: Paid print magazine subscriptions and newsstand sales at People Inc., plus paid digital subscriptions at The Daily Beast.

rights_distribution_publishers.label: Rights / distribution [publishers]
rights_distribution_publishers.value: People Inc. distributes through owned websites, print subscriptions and newsstands, and licenses brands and content. The Daily Beast distributes online and licenses content.
